name: Thibault
about: Thibault has called Mexico home since 2016. After seven years scaling tech ventures in Mexico City, he turned his energy toward what always mattered most: adventure, human connection and the power of the sea. He is building Eagle Ray one trusted relationship at a time, bringing together sea people who share the same warmth, curiosity and instinct for life at sea.
imageAlt: Thibault Poirson De Cardon, Founder of Eagle Ray Expeditions
